title: Wetlands - Vanilla Expanded
description: A mod that adds a vanilla friendly wetlands biome
body:
# Vanilla Expanded
Vanilla Expanded Wetlands is a part of the Vanilla Expanded Modpack. This mod focuses on creating a wetlands biome with additional blocks, mobs, and structures. The main goal of this mod, and the modpack as a whole, is to create a vanilla friendly overworld update in the style of an offical mojang update.
## Biome
- Wetlands
## Blocks
- Full tupelo wood set
- Clay brick block set
## Mobs
- Platypus
- Skunk
## Structure
- Wanderer's outpost
